subject: reasoning
question:
On folding the given die, which letter will be opposite to the letter 'c'?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac87e671fec2d2c00b7c7390d2cbfd0ab84e84d7ea016b198a727f314d3ce0d3.png]
solution:
The faces opposite to each other are shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34837b680533d90869691bb2f63a8f09009bc8c594a491204df987d23af953ca.png] 

⇒ As the alternate positions become opposite to each other, the remaining two faces become opposite to each other.

So, opposite pairs are:

f → e

b → d

a → c

Therefore, 'a' is the opposite of 'c'.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
